additional_findings: The fix involved changing DEFAULT_SPAWN_RADIUS from 0.05 to 0.32 which causes walkers to spawn much closer to the seed cluster, enabling better growth. Before this change, with spawn radius at 0.05, walkers were spawned far away (nearly touching the grid boundary) and rarely reached a sticky point near the cluster edge.
